hero.subtitle: The ultimate tactical advantage for the modern hooper. Find premium courts near you, track every movement with GPS precision, and dominate the leaderboard with elite analytics.

items.title: FIND YOUR COURT
items.body: Real-time court scouting. See how many players are currently on court and get live condition reports.

items.title: GPS GAME TRACKER
items.body: Automatic playtime logging and movement heatmaps. Know exactly where you dominate on the floor.

items.title: ELITE STATS
items.body: Professional-grade analytics. Track FG%, speed metrics, and verticality in every pickup game.

stats.title: MASTER YOUR
stats.desc: Don't just play—analyze. Our deep-learning algorithm breaks down your movement patterns, shot efficiency, and fatigue levels to give you a pro-ready profile.

cta.title: UNLEASH YOUR POTENTIAL
cta.subtitle: Find where to play, log every game and take your progress with you. The next court is waiting for you.

share.title: Share your results
share.body: Track your performance and share your stats with friends and on social media. Show your progress and challenge other players.

socialHub.title: SOCIAL HUB
socialHub.body: Stay connected. Chat with your crew, share highlights on social media, and scout the competition in real-time.

pickups.title: PICKUPS & EVENTS
pickups.body: Set up a run at any court, invite your crew and sort it all out in the chat: teams, tip-off time and how many points you play to.
pickups.publicBody: Post your game and anyone can jump in straight from the map, no invite needed. Perfect when you're two players short and don't want to sit out.

clan.title: CONQUER THE COURT
clan.body: Introduce your squad to the global stage. Win matches at your local park to claim the title of

discover.title: LEAVE YOUR MARK
discover.lead: We don't build the map — the people who go out looking do. Know a court that isn't listed? Add it, and it stays signed with your name for good, in plain sight of everyone who plays there after you.
discover.body: Every court you add is one more court where someone in your neighborhood gets to play tomorrow. Discoverers don't get erased: your signature stays as long as the court does.
discover.note: We review every court before publishing it to keep the map reliable. We'll let you know once it's approved.

seasons.title: TWO SEASONS A YEAR
seasons.lead: Competition is split into calendar halves. It's not a rolling window: they're fixed dates, the same for everyone, easy to remember.

why.title: Everyone starts over
why.body: Join today and you're not years behind the leader. Every January 1st and July 1st the table resets and you compete on level ground.

why.title: Titles go back on the line
why.body: King of the court and Court conquered by clan last one season. Nobody keeps the crown forever: you have to go out and defend it.

why.title: Six months is real time
why.body: Long enough that whoever actually played wins, not whoever had one good week — but short enough that a rematch is always around the corner.

seasons.keepBody: A season resets the competition, not your history: your level, your achievements and your lifetime XP stay for good. You can view your numbers by week, month, season or all time.

wearables.title: PLAY WITH YOUR WATCH ON
wearables.lead: If you play wearing a smartwatch or a band, 1of1 reads the real effort of every game —heart rate, calories, steps and distance— and turns it into metrics you can't eyeball.
wearables.comboTitle: Your body and your game, together
wearables.comboBody: The watch tells you how hard you pushed; the points you log at the end tell you how it went on court. Cross both halves and you see what neither shows alone: whether your stamina improves game after game, whether you play differently once your heart rate spikes, and where you're actually getting better.
wearables.chartFoot: Game after game, season after season.

You can report inappropriate content or users from the app and block other users. We review reports and may remove content or suspend accounts that violate these rules. We do not tolerate abusive content.

sections.heading: Account deletion

sections.body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Argentine Republic. Any dispute will be submitted to the ordinary courts of the City of Buenos Aires, without prejudice to any consumer-protection rights recognized by the law of your country of residence.

deleteAccount.title: Delete your account
deleteAccount.intro: You can delete your 1of1 account and its associated data at any time, whether or not you have the app installed.

sections.heading: From the app (instant)
sections.body: Open 1of1 → Profile → Settings → Delete account. Confirm and your account is deleted right away, no waiting.

sections.heading: Without access to the app
sections.body: Email us at francobusch130@gmail.com from the same address you signed up with, subject "Delete my account". We process the request within 30 days and confirm by email once it's done.

sections.heading: What gets deleted
sections.body: Your profile (name, handle, photo, clan badge), your match history and stats, your court reviews, your friendships, the pickups you created and their chats, and the messages you sent. Health data (Health Connect) never left your phone, so there's nothing to delete on the server.

sections.heading: What may be kept briefly
sections.body: Database backups may retain the information for a short period before being fully purged, and some records may be kept if required by law (e.g. fraud prevention).

sections.heading: Google accounts
sections.body: If you signed up with Google, deleting your 1of1 account doesn't affect your Google account. You can review the permissions you granted to 1of1 from your Google Account settings.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: 1of1 ("the app") is an application to find basketball courts and log your games. This policy explains what data we use and why.

sections.heading: What data we collect
sections.body: Account data: name, email, and optionally city and phone number you provide when signing up. Your birth date is stored to verify and confirm you meet the minimum age. Handle and profile data: public handle, clan badge, photo (if you sign in with Google), and your game stats. Location: we use it to show nearby courts and detect when you're playing; with "Always" permission, detection works with the app closed. We don't store your coordinates in our database, only which court you played at (see "Third-party services"). Health data (optional): if you connect Health (Health Connect / Apple Health), we read calories, heart rate, steps and distance — this stays ONLY on your device. Game activity: match history (court, date, duration, points). Messages: the content of pickup chats is stored on our server so we can show it to that pickup's participants.

sections.heading: What we use it for
sections.body: To make the app work: locating you on the map, detecting and scoring your games, showing your profile and rankings, and connecting the community (friends, pickups, and their chats).

sections.heading: Where it's stored
sections.body: Account, game, and message data is stored on our own backend, hosted on Render (Render Services, Inc., servers in the United States) on a Supabase Postgres database (Supabase, Inc.). Both providers act as data processors on our behalf. By using the app you accept this international data transfer to the United States. Health data never leaves your phone.

sections.heading: Third-party services
sections.body: We use Google services for map features: Google Maps (displaying the map), Geocoding (converting addresses to coordinates), and Directions (calculating routes). When you use those features, your location and/or the address queried is sent to Google. If you sign in with Google, your authentication and profile photo are provided by Google Sign-In. Google's handling of that data is governed by its own privacy policy (policies.google.com/privacy).

sections.heading: How long we keep it
sections.body: We keep your data while your account is active. If you delete your account, we remove it from our database; it may persist briefly in backups before being fully purged.

sections.heading: What other users see
sections.body: Other users can see your name, handle, badge, and public stats. In pickup chats, participants see the messages you send and your handle. Your "playing" presence, court, and time are only shared if you enable those settings in Settings → Privacy (all off by default).

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You can access, correct, or delete your data. Settings → Delete Account removes your account and data from our database (you can also do this without the app: see "Delete Account"). Email francobusch130@gmail.com to exercise any right (Argentina's Law 25.326 and, depending on your jurisdiction, equivalent rights such as CCPA/CPRA in the US).

sections.heading: Minors
sections.body: The app is not directed at children under 13 and we do not knowingly collect their data. If you are a minor, use the app with your legal guardian's authorization.

sections.heading: Changes
sections.body: We may update this policy; we'll notify you within the app. If you have questions, email francobusch130@gmail.com.
